title: Rain sends Jaffna into Playoffs, Dambulla knocked out
byline: Jaffna Kings booked their place in the Lanka Premier League 2026 playoffs after persistent rain washed out their league-stage clash against Dambulla Sixers at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium.

title: BASL seeks meeting with President over judges’ retirement age amendment
byline: The Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) has formally requested a meeting with President Anura Kumara Dissanayake to discuss the Government’s proposed constitutional amendment seeking to increase the retirement age of judges.

title: Expired dengue kits in use?
byline: In a backdrop where the dengue epidemic has claimed over 60lives, speculation is rife as to whether private medical institutions are forced to use expired diagnostic devices such as dengue NS1 antigen kits due to lack of regulations and standards.

title: Residents urged to stay alert near Kotmale Oya
byline: Three spill gates of the Upper Kotmale Reservoir opened automatically early this morning (03) following heavy rainfall in the reservoir’s catchment areas, according to engineers overseeing the reservoir.

title: Trump says Iran talks to take place on Monday, sets no deadline for deal
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said talks ​with Iran will happen on Monday but declined to set a deadline for an agreement after earlier saying he had called off an ‌imminent attack in hopes of quickly reaching a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resolve the impasse over Tehran’s nuclear capabilities.

title: Auto importers urge unified tax in budget 2027 to unlock middle-class vehicle accessibility
byline: The Ceylon Automobile Importers Association is pushing for a comprehensive overhaul of Sri Lanka’s vehicle taxation system in the upcoming Budget 2027, proposing a unified fee structure designed to make cars affordable again for the country’s middle class.

title: Inflation hits three-year high as CB’s target breach stretches to fourth month
byline: Sri Lanka’s headline inflation accelerated to 7.3 percent in July 2026, up from 6.8 percent in June — the highest reading since June 2023,

title: Colombo–Kandy road closed between Kadugannawa and Ganethenna
byline: The Colombo–Kandy main road has been temporarily closed between Kadugannawa and Ganethenna due to the risk of rocks sliding onto the roadway, Police said.

title: Dik Oya overflow floods houses in Hatton
byline: Several houses located along the banks of Dik Oya in Hatton were inundated today (3) after the stream, which carries water from Hatton to the Castlereagh Reservoir, overflowed following heavy rainfall.

title: Indictments filed against Yoshitha Rajapaksa and Karannagoda
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption has filed indictments before the Colombo High Court against Yoshitha Rajapaksa, son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa and former Navy Commander Admiral of the Fleet Wasantha Karannagoda over alleged corruption charges.

title: Suicide bomber targets rally in Pakistan, killing at least 14
byline: At least 14 people have been killed in a suicide bombing that targeted protesters at an anti-militant rally in northwestern Pakistan, officials say.

title: Landslide evacuation warning issued for parts of Kandy
byline: The National Building Research Organisation (NBRO) has issued a Level 3 ’Evacuation’ landslide warning for the Pasbage Korale and Ganga Ihala Korale Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Kandy District due to the prevailing adverse weather conditions.

title: Patients at risk due to leadership vacuum at J’pura hospital, Doctor claims
byline: The failure to appoint a qualified director to the Jayawardenapura General Hospital has triggered an administrative crisis that is putting patient care at risk, Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights Chairman and Specialist Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa alleged. He said the Health Ministry has failed for more than a year to appoint a qualified medical specialist with expertise in hospital administration to head the institution.

title: Govt. to seek SC opinion on confusion regarding terms of President and Parliament
byline: The government is out to seek the opinion of Supreme court on a so called confusion in the constitution with regard to the terms of the Executive President and Parliament, and opposition the MP alleged.

title: Flash flood warning issued for Gelioya, Peradeniya
byline: People living in Gelioya town and in buildings within the University of Peradeniya located near the Mahaweli River have been urged to remain vigilant due to the risk of sudden flooding.

title: River levels rise after heavy rain; residents in low-lying areas urged to remain alert
byline: The Department of Irrigation said water levels in the upper reaches of the Mahaweli, Kelani and Kalu rivers have risen rapidly following heavy rainfall in the island’s wet zone over the past 24 hours.

title: Second shipping container washes ashore on Southern coast
byline: A shipping container washed ashore near Owakanda Junction in the Rathgama Police Division this morning (03), police said.

title: Sri Lanka Debaters Make History at World Schools Debating Championship
byline: National team ranks 1st out of over 80 countries after preliminary rounds

title: Drug regulation has collapsed, patients’ lives at risk: Specialist
byline: The Medical and Civil Rights Doctors’ Union, has alleged that Sri Lanka’s drug regulatory system has ’’collapsed,’’ warning that patients’ lives are being placed at serious risk due to delays in approving medicines and persistent shortages of essential drugs.

title: Harsha says no to govt. crossover but says govt searching for people like him
byline: Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) MP Harsha de Silva yesterday scoffed rumors that were being circulated in the media about a crossover to the government.

title: Security tightened across all prisons following Mahara Prison unrest
byline: Authorities have stepped up security at prisons across the country after the violent unrest at the Mahara Prison left one inmate dead, several others injured, and caused extensive damage to prison property.

title: Container which fell into the sea at Colombo appears in Bentota
byline: One of the containers that fell into the sea from the merchant ship in the sea off Colombo harbour has been washed ashore at Athuruwella in Induruwa in Bentota yesterday.

title: Major flood warning issued for Kelani River Valley
byline: The Irrigation Department has issued a major flood warning for low-lying areas of the Kelani River Valley, stating that a major flood situation could develop within the next 24 hours due to heavy rainfall in the upper and middle catchment areas of the river basin.

title: Electricity tariffs to remain unchanged in third quarter
byline: The Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) has decided to maintain existing electricity tariffs during the third quarter of 2026, despite an increase in electricity generation costs.

title: Heavy showers above 100 mm forecast for several areas
byline: Heavy rainfall exceeding 100 mm is likely at some places in the Sabaragamuwa Province and in the Kandy and Nuwara Eliya districts, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Cuba suffers yet another nationwide blackout
byline: Cuba’s state-owned grid operator said the island’s power system collapsed late on Sunday, the latest in a series of rolling power cuts caused by aging infrastructure and a US energy embargo.

title: All government schools in Kandy District also to remain closed
byline: In light of the prevailing severe adverse weather conditions, a decision has been taken to close all government schools in the Kandy District tomorrow (4).

title: Nuwara Eliya schools to remain closed tomorrow due to bad weather
byline: All government schools in the Nuwara Eliya District will be closed tomorrow (04) owing to severe weather conditions, according to the Director of the Nuwara Eliya Education Division.

title: Mahanayake Theras oppose proposal to extend judges’ retirement age: BASL President
byline: The Mahanayake Theras of the three Buddhist chapters have written to President Anura Kumara Dissanayake stating that the proposed constitutional amendment to extend the retirement age of judges is inappropriate, President of the Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) Rajeev Amarasuriya said.

title: University of Peradeniya suspends academic activities due to adverse weather
byline: The University of Peradeniya has temporarily suspended all academic activities and examinations until further notice due to the prevailing adverse weather conditions.

title: Jay Shah’s Tanzania milestone, US ban, Sri Lanka gold & FIFA leadership crisis
byline: Global sports headlines featured a new cricket milestone in Tanzania, a major anti-corruption ban, Sri Lanka’s Commonwealth Games gold and fresh FIFA leadership controversy.

title: Office of Commission on Public Sector Salaries, Pensions to open tomorrow
byline: The office of the Commission on Public Sector Salaries and Pensions, appointed to introduce reforms in the salaries and pension systems of public sector officials, will be opened tomorrow (04), the President’s Media Division (PMD) said.

title: Bumrah ruled out, Aaqib Nabi earns India test call-up
byline: India have called up Jammu & Kashmir pacer Aaqib Nabi to replace injured Jasprit Bumrah for the two-Test series against Sri Lanka. Bumrah has been ruled out after failing to recover fully from a left knee niggle, while Nabi receives his maiden Test squad call-up after impressive domestic performances.

title: Earth mound collapses on house in Hatton, four missing
byline: At least four individuals went missing after a mound of earth collapsed onto a house at Morahenagama in Polpitiya police division in Hatton today, Police said.

title: Rains to ease by tomorrow afternoon: Met. Department
byline: Director General of the Department of Meteorology, Ajith Wijemanne said the prevailing rainy weather will ease by tomorrow (4, Tuesday) afternoon while Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, the Sabaragamuwa Province and some parts of the Western Province will continue to receive rains tonight and early tomorrow morning.

title: Gotabaya’s writ petition fixed for order
byline: The Court of Appeal today fixed September 22 to deliver its order on the writ petition filed by former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa, seeking an order preventing his arrest in connection with ongoing investigations into the 2019 Easter Sunday terror attacks.

title: Communist Party urges President to act on Indian trawler issue affecting Jaffna fishermen
byline: The Communist Party of Sri Lanka (CPSL) has urged President Anura Kumara Dissanayake to take immediate steps to address the longstanding issue of Indian fishing trawlers entering Sri Lankan waters and affecting the livelihoods of fishermen in the Jaffna District.

title: President reaffirms need to abolish executive presidency
byline: Representatives of an alliance formed by six Tamil and Muslim political parties met with President Anura Kumara Dissanayake at the Presidential Secretariat this morning (3) where they discussed several matters including the conduct of the elections and introduction of a comprehensive new Constitution.

title: Kotmale reservoir spill gates opened; flood warning issued for downstream areas
byline: The Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority has begun opening the spill gates and mud sluice of the Gamini Dissanayake Reservoir in Kotmale from 3.00 p.m. today (Aug. 3) due to the continuing heavy rainfall in the upper catchment area.

title: CoPF approves Rs. 71.7 Billion relief package to mitigate impact of Middle East conflict
byline: The Committee on Public Finance (CoPF) has approved the Rs. 71.7 billion relief package allocated through Supplementary Estimate No. 03 of 2026 to provide relief to those affected by the economic repercussions arising from the conflict in the Middle East.

title: Morocco names longest highway after Donald Trump
byline: Morocco has named its 1,055-km. Tiznit-Dakhla expressway the “Donald J. Trump Highway” in recognition of the US president’s support for Rabat’s sovereignty claim over Western Sahara, the Moroccan state news agency MAP reported on Saturday.

title: Oil prices drop 5% to three-week low after Trump cancels attack on Iran
byline: Oil prices fell about 5% to a ​three-week low on Monday after U.S. President Donald Trump held off on a fresh attack on Iran in the hope of sealing a quick ‌deal that could boost oil supplies from the Gulf.

title: Fishing community warned of floating containers on southern seas
byline: The Fisheries Department has warned all fishermen including multi-day fishing trawlers navigating the southern seas to remain extremely vigilant of the containers that fell into the sea two days ago.

title: Cuba suffers yet another nationwide blackout
byline: Cuba’s state-owned grid operator said the island’s power system collapsed late on Sunday, the latest in a series of rolling power cuts caused by aging infrastructure and a US energy embargo.
